verdict.rationale: Pulumi applies changes across many resources in a single operation. Users can create many items with language loops, and `pulumi preview --import-file` generates an import file listing every resource for bulk import. Policies apply guardrails consistently across all resources, and a hands-on user reports deployments of roughly 500 resources each. missing for 10: explicit docs framing bulk update/delete or targeted multi-item operations, bulk actions via the MCP/AI path, independent corroboration of bulk import at scale.
